# Vendored libraries

- `supabase-js-2.108.0.min.js`: supabase-js, MIT, Supabase.
- `qrcode-generator-1.4.4.min.js`: qrcode-generator, MIT, Kazuhiko Arase. Draws the join code as a QR.
- `jsQR-1.4.0.js`: jsQR, Apache License 2.0, Cosmo Wolfe. Reads a QR from the camera where the browser has no BarcodeDetector; loaded only when scanning starts.
